payload.title: The farm-service common registry (sites, departments, suppliers, supplier sites, consumables, finance categories and entries) has no owner-module key, so every row is implicitly farm, sensor and HR read it as their own, and no read can be narrowed to a module grant nor a cross-module link refused
evidence: apps/farm-service/src/site/entities/site.entity.ts:139-145 (sites has no module column; code and name are unique per tenant only)
apps/farm-service/src/supplier/entities/supplier-site.entity.ts:35-38 (supplier-to-site link is keyed by ids alone; nothing ties the supplier and the site to one module)
apps/farm-service/src/finance/entities/finance-expense-entry.entity.ts:110-112 (ledger entry siteId is a bare nullable uuid with no module)
apps/farm-service/src/site/site.resolver.ts:167-176 (the sites list takes no module argument; only the global role and site assignment shape it)
web/modules/sensor-module/src/hooks/useLocationHierarchy.ts:52-54 (sensor-module lists the same farm sites as its own locations)
web/modules/hr-module/src/graphql/site-responsibility.operations.ts:18-20 (hr-module reads activeSites from the same registry)
payload.rule_violated: D1 and the section 2 target model: common kinds (sites, site departments, suppliers, consumables, module ledgers) are keyed by module with moduleCode NOT NULL and are read by holders of that module's grant
payload.notes: Program module-boundaries, package PKG-13, release R7.
